class.name: InputMapSettingsAction
class.brief_description: One action as stored in the file of [InputMapSettingsServer].
class.description: The file form of an [InputAction] in the settings file of [InputMapSettingsServer]: the name, the deadzone, the layer and one [InputMapSettingsEvent] per event. [InputMapSettingsServer] converts between [InputActions] and these records when it saves and loads; games do not need this class.

members.member: The events of the action, in the order of the action.

The layer of the action in [InputMap]: [constant LAYER_BUILT_IN] for the [code]ui_*[/code] actions, [constant LAYER_CUSTOM] for the actions of the project. It is written for information; the project decides the layer when the file is loaded.

constants.constant: A built-in action of the engine.
